name: Undecidability.FP.evalWord_eq_mk
statement:
theorem evalWord_eq_mk (P : FP n m) (w : Word n) :
    P.evalWord w = PresentedGroup.mk P.relSet (FreeGroup.mk w)

name: Undecidability.FP.homOfRelators_evalWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOfRelators_evalWord {G : Type*} [_root_.Group G] (P : FP n m)
    (x : Fin n → G) (h : ∀ i, Word.eval x (P.relator i) = 1) (w : Word n) :
    P.homOfRelators x h (P.evalWord w) = Word.eval x w

name: Undecidability.FP.homOfRelators_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOfRelators_of {G : Type*} [_root_.Group G] (P : FP n m)
    (x : Fin n → G) (h : ∀ i, Word.eval x (P.relator i) = 1) (i : Fin n) :
    P.homOfRelators x h (PresentedGroup.of i) = x i

name: Undecidability.FP.presentsTrivial_iff_subsingleton
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_iff_subsingleton (P : FP n m) :
    P.presentsTrivial ↔ Subsingleton P.Group

name: Undecidability.FP.presentsTrivial_of_generator_eq_one
statement:
theorem presentsTrivial_of_generator_eq_one (P : FP n m)
    (h : ∀ i, (PresentedGroup.of i : P.Group) = 1) : P.presentsTrivial

name: Undecidability.FP.relator_eq_one
statement:
theorem relator_eq_one (P : FP n m) (i : Fin m) :
    P.evalWord (P.relator i) = 1

name: Undecidability.FP.wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one
statement:
theorem wordProblem_iff_evalWord_eq_one (P : FP n m) (w : Word n) :
    P.wordProblem w ↔ P.evalWord w = 1

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_append {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (u v : Word n) :
    eval x (u ++ v) = eval x u * eval x v

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_commutator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_commutator {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (u v : Word n) :
    eval x (commutator u v) =
      (eval x u)⁻¹ * (eval x v)⁻¹ * eval x u * eval x v

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_generator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_generator {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (i : Fin n) :
    eval x (generator i) = x i

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_inverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_inverse {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (w : Word n) :
    eval x (inverse w) = (eval x w)⁻¹

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_mapGenerators
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_mapGenerators {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin k → G) (f : Fin n → Fin k) (w : Word n) :
    eval x (mapGenerators f w) = eval (x ∘ f) w

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_mul {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (u v : Word n) :
    eval x (mul u v) = eval x u * eval x v

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_pow {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (w : Word n) (k : ℕ) :
    eval x (pow w k) = eval x w ^ k

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_product
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_product {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (ws : List (Word n)) :
    eval x (product ws) = (ws.map (eval x)).prod

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_relation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_relation {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (lhs rhs : Word n) :
    eval x (relation lhs rhs) = eval x lhs * (eval x rhs)⁻¹

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_relation_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem eval_relation_eq_one_iff {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (lhs rhs : Word n) :
    eval x (relation lhs rhs) = 1 ↔ eval x lhs = eval x rhs

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_substitute
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_substitute {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin k → G) (s : Fin n → Word k) (w : Word n) :
    eval x (substitute s w) = eval (fun i => eval x (s i)) w

name: Undecidability.Word.eval_substitutePositive
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_substitutePositive {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (x : Fin n → G) (s₁ s₂ : Word n) (w : List (Fin 2)) :
    eval x (substitutePositive s₁ s₂ w) =
      (w.map fun i => if i = 0 then eval x s₁ else eval x s₂).prod

name: Undecidability.Word.inverse_inverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverse_inverse (w : Word n) : inverse (inverse w) = w

name: Undecidability.Word.inverse_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverse_mul (u v : Word n) :
    inverse (mul u v) = mul (inverse v) (inverse u)

name: Undecidability.Word.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H]
    (f : G →* H) (x : Fin n → G) (w : Word n) :
    f (eval x w) = eval (f ∘ x) w

name: Undecidability.Word.mk_inverse
statement:
theorem mk_inverse (w : Word n) :
    FreeGroup.mk (inverse w) = (FreeGroup.mk w)⁻¹

name: Undecidability.Word.substitute_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem substitute_append {A : Type*} (s : A → Word n)
    (u v : List (A × Bool)) :
    substitute s (u ++ v) = mul (substitute s u) (substitute s v)

name: Undecidability.Word.substitute_flatten
statement:
@[simp]
theorem substitute_flatten {A : Type*} (s : A → Word n)
    (ws : List (List (A × Bool))) :
    substitute s ws.flatten = product (ws.map (substitute s))

name: Undecidability.Word.substitute_invRev
statement:
@[simp]
theorem substitute_invRev {A : Type*} (s : A → Word n)
    (w : List (A × Bool)) :
    substitute s (FreeGroup.invRev w) = inverse (substitute s w)

name: Undecidability.isAdianRabinFamily_of_wordProblem_reduction

theorem eval_encodeWord {H : Type*} [Group H]

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_additional
statement:

theorem transform_additional (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.transform_old
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transform_old (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Condition21.normalizedQ_pos

statement:
theorem normalizedSelected_preimage (condition : Condition21 P)

theorem normalized_gcd (condition : Condition21 P) :

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_alpha_witness

theorem eval_alpha_witness (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_encodedGenerator_witness
statement:
theorem eval_encodedGenerator_witness

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.eval_rightConjugateWord_witness

theorem eval_rightConjugateWord_witness

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.identifies_basis
statement:
theorem identifies_basis (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)

statement:
theorem transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective

name: Undecidability.Gordon.Amalgam.witnessHom_of

theorem witnessHom_of (P : FP n m) (data : TorsionData P)

name: Monoid.CoprodI.NeWord.merge_last_of_isAppend_right

name: Monoid.CoprodI.NeWord.merge_last_singleton

name: Monoid.CoprodI.NeWord.merge_prod

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.column_getD
statement:
theorem column_getD {t : ℕ} (rows : Fin t → List (Fin 2))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.column_last
statement:
theorem column_last {t width : ℕ}
    (rows : Fin t → List (Fin 2))
    (hwidth : 0 < width)

    (hend : ∀ i, ∃ init, rows i = init ++ [(1 : Fin 2)]) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.columnsFrom_getD
statement:
theorem columnsFrom_getD {t : ℕ} (rows : Fin t → List (Fin 2))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.columnsFrom_last
statement:
theorem columnsFrom_last {t : ℕ}
    (rows : Fin t → List (Fin 2)) (start k : ℕ) :

      columnsFrom rows start k ++ column rows (start + k)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.expand_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem expand_cons (u : ℕ) (x : Fin 2) (W : List (Fin 2)) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.expand_length
statement:
theorem expand_length (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    (expand u W).length = W.length * 2 ^ u

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.expand_length_dvd
statement:
theorem expand_length_dvd (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    2 ^ u ∣ (expand u W).length

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.firstNormal_replicate_e_liftBinary
statement:
theorem firstNormal_replicate_e_liftBinary (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.liftBinary_transpose_ends_b
statement:
theorem liftBinary_transpose_ends_b {t width : ℕ}
    (rows : Fin t → List (Fin 2))

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.paddedTransposeLast_getD_last

theorem paddedTransposeLast_getD_last {t width : ℕ}

Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.pushE_liftBinary_even

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_append_of_even
statement:
theorem selectOdd_append_of_even {α : Type*} (X Y : List α)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_cons_cons

@[simp] theorem selectOdd_cons_cons {α : Type*} (x y : α) (W : List α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_expandBlock
statement:
theorem selectOdd_expandBlock (k : ℕ) (x : Fin 2) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_getD
statement:
theorem selectOdd_getD {α : Type*} (W : List α) (i : ℕ) (d : α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_length
statement:
theorem selectOdd_length {α : Type*} (W : List α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem selectOdd_nil {α : Type*} : selectOdd ([] : List α) = []

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.selectOdd_prefix_affineSample
statement:
theorem selectOdd_prefix_affineSample (u : ℕ)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_append_of_dvd
statement:
theorem thin_append_of_dvd {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) (X Y : List α)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_expand
statement:
@[simp] theorem thin_expand (u : ℕ) (W : List (Fin 2)) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_expandBlock
statement:
theorem thin_expandBlock (u : ℕ) (x : Fin 2) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_getD
statement:
theorem thin_getD {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) (W : List α) (i : ℕ) (d : α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_length
statement:
theorem thin_length {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) (W : List α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem thin_nil {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) : thin u ([] : List α) = []

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_paddedTranspose_last
statement:
theorem thin_paddedTranspose_last (u width : ℕ)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem thin_succ {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) (W : List α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.thin_succ_comm
statement:
theorem thin_succ_comm {α : Type*} (u : ℕ) (W : List α) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.RowSelection.transpose_ends_b

statement:
theorem process_affine (l : List A₂) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem process_cons_e (l : List A₂) (W : List (Fin 2)) :

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.process_cons_ne
statement:
theorem process_cons_ne (x : A₂) (l : List A₂) (W : List (Fin 2))
    (hx : x ≠ e) :
    process (x :: l) W = lowerBit x :: process l W

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.process_periodic_shift
statement:
theorem process_periodic_shift (l : List A₂)
    (W₁ W₂ : List (Fin 2)) (k : ℕ)
    (hlen : W₂.length = W₁.length + k * 2 ^ eCount l) :
    (Processable l W₁ ↔ Processable l W₂) ∧
      (process l W₂).length = (process l W₁).length + k

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.process_replace_transpose
statement:
theorem process_replace_transpose (l : List A₂) (p q : ℕ)
    (leftRows rightRows : Fin (2 ^ eCount l) → List (Fin 2))
    (R : List (Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, (leftRows i).length = p)
    (hq : ∀ i, (rightRows i).length = q) :
    ∃ P : List (Fin 2), ∃ j : Fin (2 ^ eCount l), ∃ S : List (Fin 2),
      process l (transpose p leftRows ++ R) =
          P ++ leftRows j ++ S ∧
        process l (transpose q rightRows ++ R) =
          P ++ rightRows j ++ S

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.processable_cons_e_iff
statement:
theorem processable_cons_e_iff (l : List A₂) (W : List (Fin 2)) :
    Processable (e :: l) W ↔
      Processable l W ∧ 2 ∣ (process l W).length

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.processable_cons_ne_iff
statement:
theorem processable_cons_ne_iff (x : A₂) (l : List A₂)
    (W : List (Fin 2)) (hx : x ≠ e) :
    Processable (x :: l) W ↔ Processable l W

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.processable_of_firstNormal_clean
statement:
theorem processable_of_firstNormal_clean (l : List A₂) (W B : List (Fin 2))
    (hclean : firstNormal (l ++ liftBinary W) =
      liftBinary B ++ List.replicate (eCount l) e) :
    Processable l W ∧ process l W = B

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.processable_replace_transpose
statement:
theorem processable_replace_transpose (l : List A₂) (p q : ℕ)
    (leftRows : Fin (2 ^ eCount l) → List (Fin 2))
    (rightRows : Fin (2 ^ eCount l) → List (Fin 2))
    (R : List (Fin 2)) :
    Processable l (transpose p leftRows ++ R) ↔
      Processable l (transpose q rightRows ++ R)

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.pushE_clean_inv
statement:
theorem pushE_clean_inv (W : List A₂) (B : List (Fin 2)) (v : ℕ)
    (hcount : eCount W = v)
    (hclean : pushE W = liftBinary B ++ List.replicate (v + 1) e) :
    ∃ C : List (Fin 2),
      W = liftBinary C ++ List.replicate v e ∧
      2 ∣ C.length ∧ selectOdd C = B

name: Undecidability.Thue.Matiyasevich1993.Priority.ContextualSelection.replace_transpose_clean
statement:
theorem replace_transpose_clean (u p q : ℕ)
    (leftRows rightRows : Fin (2 ^ u) → List (Fin 2))
    (hp : ∀ i, (leftRows i).length = p)
    (hq : ∀ i, (rightRows i).length = q)
    (hleftEnd : ∀ i, ∃ init, leftRows i = init ++ [(1 : Fin 2)])
    (_hrightEnd : ∀ i, ∃ init, rightRows i = init ++ [(1 : Fin 2)])
    {l r : List A₂} {B : List (Fin 2)}
    (hl : eCount l = u) (hr : eCount r = 0)
    (hclean : firstNormal
      (l ++ liftBinary (transpose p leftRows) ++ r) = encode u B) :
    ∃ j : Fin (2 ^ u), ∃ left right : List (Fin 2),
      B = left ++ leftRows j ++ right ∧
        firstNormal (l ++ liftBinary (transpose q rightRows) ++ r) =
          encode u (left ++ rightRows j ++ right)

name: Undecidability.HNNLemmas.congrHom_of

@[simp]
theorem congrHom_of
    {G' : Type*} [Group G'] {A' B' : Subgroup G'} {φ' : A' ≃* B'}
    (e : G ≃* G') (eA : A ≃* A') (eB : B ≃* B')
    (hA : ∀ a : A, (eA a : G') = e (a : G))
    (hB : ∀ b : B, (eB b : G') = e (b : G))
    (hφ : ∀ a : A, eB (phi a) = φ' (eA a)) (g : G) :
    congrHom e eA eB hA hB hφ
        (HNNExtension.of (A := A) (B := B) (φ := phi) g) =
      HNNExtension.of (A := A') (B := B') (φ := φ') (e g)

    (hA : ∀ a : A, (eA a : G') = e (a : G))
    (hB : ∀ b : B, (eB b : G') = e (b : G))
    (hφ : ∀ a : A, eB (phi a) = φ' (eA a)) :
    congrHom e eA eB hA hB hφ

    ∃ (pre : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3))
      (u : ℤˣ) (a : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (v : ℤˣ) (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)),
      L.word.toList = pre ++ [(u, a)] ∧
      R.word.toList = (v, b) :: tail ∧

      (b : BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)
      (tail : List (ℤˣ × BorisovHNNModel.Gamma3)),
      (L.word.toList = pre ++ [(1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)] ∧
        R.word.toList = (-1, b) :: tail ∧
        R.word.head = BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∧
        BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f * positive3 Q *
            BorisovHNNModel.e3 ^ r ∈ U datum) ∨
      (L.word.toList = pre ++ [(-1, BorisovHNNModel.d3 ^ f)] ∧
        R.word.toList = (1, b) :: tail ∧

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.inversionAction_nat
statement:

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.invertFactors_pow_letterProd

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.invertFactors_pow_modE

    (invertFactors ^ n) (CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) x) =
      CoprodI.of (M := Factor5) (i := i) ((invertC5 ^ n) x)

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.letterProd_append

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientStable_pow_left

name: Undecidability.BorisovModFiveBaseWords.quotientStable_pow_right

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_oldWord_witness

theorem eval_oldWord_witness (P : FP n m) (z w u : Word n) :

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₁_witness
statement:
theorem eval_sigma₁_witness (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) :

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₂_witness

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.eval_sigma₄_witness

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.identifies_basis

theorem identifies_basis (P : FP n m) (z w : Word n) (i : Fin 5) :

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.identifies_beta

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.transform_not_trivial_of_basis_injective

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_beta

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessGenerator_gamma

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.Amalgam.witnessHom_of

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.outerLeftBasis_injective_of_tailImage

    (tailImage_prod : ∀ (x : FreeGroup (Fin 4)) (hx : x ≠ 1),

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftSplit.splitLift_injective_of_tailImage

name: Undecidability.MillerTancer.LeftInjective.leftPowerWord4_negSucc
statement:
